title: A GOD WHO ACTS LIKE NO OTHER

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: Has any other people heard the voice of God speaking out of fire, as you have, and lived? Has any god ever tried to take for himself one nation out of another nation, by testings, by signs and wonders, by war, by a mighty hand and an outstretched arm, or by great and awesome deeds, like all the things the Lord your God did for you in Egypt before your very eyes? You were shown these things so that you might know that the Lord is God; besides him there is no other. - Deut 4:33-35 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Moses piles up the evidence of God's uniqueness. No other people had heard God's voice from the fire and lived. No other god had ever done what Israel's God did — reaching into Egypt to take a whole nation for Himself, by signs, wonders, and a mighty hand. The purpose of it all is stated plainly: "You were shown these things so that you might know that the Lord is God; besides him there is no other." God revealed His power so His people would know that He alone is God.

This is the great truth at the heart of the Bible: there is only one true God, and He alone is worthy of worship. The idols of the nations were nothing; the Lord alone is God, over all heaven and earth. Everything God did for Israel was meant to teach them, and us, this foundational truth. He alone is God, and there is no other.

This knowledge is meant to shape everything about how we live. If the Lord alone is God, then He alone deserves our worship, our trust, and our obedience. Every rival for our hearts is exposed as a false god that cannot compare. The uniqueness of God calls for the wholeness of our devotion.

God's greatest act of revealing Himself was still to come — greater even than the exodus. In sending His Son, God showed His power and love most fully. Through the death and resurrection of Jesus, God defeated sin and death and revealed Himself as the one true God and Savior. As we behold what God has done in Christ, we too come to know beyond doubt that the Lord is God, and besides Him there is no other. Let this truth anchor your worship and your life.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Does the truth that "the Lord alone is God" shape how you live?
2. What rivals for your devotion does this truth expose as false?
3. How has God revealed Himself most fully to you in Christ?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, You alone are God, and besides You there is no other. Let this truth anchor my worship and my life. Help me give You my whole devotion, as I behold Your power and love revealed fully in Christ. Amen.
